steps.description: Process the ubiquitin PDB file, assign the AMBER99SB-ILDN force field, generate topology, and prepare the structure for solvation.

steps.command: gmx solvate -cp protein_processed.gro -cs spc216.gro -o solvated.gro -p topol.top -box 4.0 4.0 4.0
steps.description: Place the protein in a cubic water box with a minimum distance of 1.0 nm from the box edge using TIP3P water molecules.

steps.command: gmx grompp -f ions.mdp -c solvated.gro -p topol.top -o ions.tpr && gmx genion -s ions.tpr -o solvated_ions.gro -p topol.top -pname NA -nname CL -neutral
steps.description: Replace solvent molecules with Na+ and Cl- ions to neutralize the system charge.

steps.command: gmx grompp -f em.mdp -c solvated_ions.gro -p topol.top -o em.tpr && gmx mdrun -deffnm em -v -nb gpu -pme gpu
steps.description: Perform energy minimization using steepest descent algorithm to remove steric clashes and high-energy contacts.

steps.command: gmx grompp -f nvt.mdp -c em.gro -p topol.top -o nvt.tpr && gmx mdrun -deffnm nvt -v -nb gpu -pme gpu -bonded gpu
steps.description: Run NVT equilibration at 300 K for 100 ps using V-rescale thermostat to stabilize temperature.

steps.command: gmx grompp -f npt.mdp -c nvt.gro -p topol.top -o npt.tpr && gmx mdrun -deffnm npt -v -nb gpu -pme gpu -bonded gpu
steps.description: Run NPT equilibration at 300 K and 1 bar for 100 ps using Parrinello-Rahman barostat to stabilize density and pressure.

estimated_compute: 2 hours on 8 CPU cores + 1 NVIDIA GPU
validation_checks: Energy minimization must converge with max force < 1000 kJ/mol/nm
Temperature must stabilize around 300 K during NVT with fluctuations < 5 K
Density must converge to ~1000 kg/m3 during NPT
RMSD of protein backbone must plateau after initial relaxation
Box volume must remain stable during NPT equilibration
